subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should the Control UI continue using composer takeover during an active run only if Stop/abort remains directly reachable without collapsing the question panel?
rationale: The PR introduces a cross-platform interaction model and the explicit active-run control placement is a user-facing product decision, not merely a test gap.

options.title: Preserve takeover with always-visible abort
options.body: Keep the expanded question panel as the composer replacement, while rendering Stop/abort controls outside the hidden composer whenever an active run can be cancelled.

options.title: Disable takeover during active runs
options.body: Show the standard composer controls while a run is active and reserve full takeover for non-running question states.

recommendation.title: Preserve takeover with always-visible abort
recommendation.body: Keep the expanded question panel as the composer replacement, while rendering Stop/abort controls outside the hidden composer whenever an active run can be cancelled.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history makes steipete the best available routing candidate for the proposed question-surface interaction, pending maintainer confirmation.
